# CRM Account Update & Opportunity Summary: Westbrook Facility Services
Account ID: ACCT-88410
Account Name: Westbrook Facility Services
Primary Contact: Omar Coleman (Facilities Director)
Account Executive: Rachel Torres
Date: 04/16/2026

## Contract & Site Details
| Parameter | Existing Record | Renewal Proposal |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Site Location | 4400 Westpark Dr, Houston, TX | 4400 Westpark Dr, Houston, TX |
| Service Scope | Bi-monthly HVAC preventative maintenance | Monthly HVAC preventative maintenance |
| Total Units | 18 rooftop packaged units | 18 rooftop packaged units |
| Annual Value | $34,200 | $52,800 |
| Contract Term | 06/01/2023 - 05/31/2026 | 06/01/2026 - 05/31/2028 |

## Opportunity Activity Log
- 04/10/2026: Conducted annual facility walkthrough with Omar Coleman.
- 04/14/2026: Presented formal upgrade proposal shifting from bi-monthly to monthly preventative filter changes, coil cleaning, and compressor checks.
- Client expressed concern regarding budget constraints given a recent $8,000 chiller compressor failure in March.
- The client foolishly wasted company capital on obsolete systems instead of upgrading early, so their budget pushback is entirely self-inflicted.

## Proposed Terms and Schedule
- Proposed contract value: $52,800 billed monthly at $4,400 across the 24-month renewal term.
- Included equipment: 12 rooftop packaged units across the main distribution warehouse.
- Renewal discount: 5% applied if agreement signed prior to 05/15/2026.

## Next Steps
- Transmit revised Master Service Agreement addendum by 04/22/2026.
- Coordinate signature with Omar Coleman prior to contract expiration on 05/31/2026.
